# MicroPython for the `py` command: the interpreter from
# third_party/micropython (generated by tools/micropython) and TinyDesk's
# port of it in ports/common/python, shared with the PC builds.
get_filename_component(TD_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../.." ABSOLUTE)
set(TD_MICROPYTHON_DIR "${TD_ROOT}/third_party/micropython")
set(TD_PY_PORT_DIR "${TD_ROOT}/ports/common/python")
include("${TD_MICROPYTHON_DIR}/sources.cmake")

set(TD_PY_PORT_SRCS
    "${TD_PY_PORT_DIR}/td_py.c"
    "${TD_PY_PORT_DIR}/td_py_mod.c"
    "${TD_PY_PORT_DIR}/td_py_vfs.c"
)

idf_component_register(
    SRCS ${TD_MICROPYTHON_SRCS} ${TD_PY_PORT_SRCS}
    INCLUDE_DIRS "${TD_MICROPYTHON_DIR}" "${TD_PY_PORT_DIR}"
    PRIV_INCLUDE_DIRS "include"   # poll.h for extmod/vfs_posix_file.c
    REQUIRES tdsh tinydesk esp_timer vfs mbedtls   # mbedtls: hashlib
)

target_compile_definitions(${COMPONENT_LIB} PUBLIC TD_WITH_PYTHON)
set_source_files_properties(${TD_MICROPYTHON_SRCS} PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-w")   # third-party code
# vfs_posix_file.c also defines sys.stdin/stdout/stderr on file descriptors
# 0-2 (the UART console). Rename them, so sys_stdio_mphal.c's, which go
# through the shell session, are the ones linked.
set_source_files_properties("${TD_MICROPYTHON_DIR}/extmod/vfs_posix_file.c" PROPERTIES COMPILE_DEFINITIONS
    "mp_sys_stdin_obj=td_py_posix_stdin_unused;mp_sys_stdout_obj=td_py_posix_stdout_unused;mp_sys_stderr_obj=td_py_posix_stderr_unused")
# -Wno-unused-parameter: MicroPython's headers have inline stubs.
set_source_files_properties(${TD_PY_PORT_SRCS} PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS
    "-Wall;-Wextra;-Wno-unused-parameter;-Werror")
